_note: Core balance numbers. Edit and reload; no code changes needed. Times are in seconds of game time. Gatherers plan each trip (sim/folk_ai.gd plan_trip): gather_trip_slack pads their walking estimate for detours, and gather_need_floor is how much they still value a good the town already has enough of (a full shortage counts 1).
_tower_note: A sentient raider shot by a tower (a building with tower_hp) goes for that tower for tower_grudge_seconds, attacking from tower_reach past its own attack range.
_hunger_note: Everyone eats food_per_person_per_day at each dawn, heroes included. When there isn't enough, one townsperson walks away and every hero's mood drops; with hunger_turns_folk_away, word gets round and nobody of the leaver's role comes to that dawn's pick.
_build_cards_note: Blueprints (Yusuf's pick 2026-10-22, replacing one-use building cards): each round's build phase offers blueprint_offers buildings to draft (a row offer counts among them); a drafted building can be ordered, paying its cost, for the rest of the run up to its max. The first round brings blueprint_first_picks drafts, every later round blueprint_picks, and reaching a new age blueprint_age_picks more; drafts not taken carry over. Offers are drawn without repeats from buildings not yet drafted, weight 1 each, times build_need_weight when the town needs that kind (housing almost full, food short, heroes without beds or no hero lodging at all, a stall nobody supplies or a workshop with no stall, the nodes a building tends under build_tend_below full, a fuel maker while fuel is under two nights, or what the next age-up requires), times build_new_weight for a building the town has never had. A building of the town's current age it has never had counts as needed. The building the next age-up requires is always offered until drafted. Ageing up is a card of its own whenever it can be raised. One reroll of the offers a round for build_redraw_cost shells, while a draft is left.
_rows_note: Rows (data/combos.json): a draft offers at most row_cards rows; a drafted row orders two buildings side by side for both costs less row_discount (0.2 = a fifth off, rounded down).
_wave_sides_note: The warned wave marches by the way of a den still standing (or the war camp), from wherever the shifting earth has carried it (sim/world.gd roll_wave_sides); a second side from wave_two_sides_from_round must be at least wave_sides_apart degrees from the first, and with no den left on a free side it comes from open country on a compass side.
_find_note: Earth finds (starstone by a waking ridge, a sunk den's hoard): a hero whose trait greed plus wilds (data/heroes.json, wilds from their whim when it has one) is at least find_appetite goes to dig one out by day, from up to find_reach farther out than the den ring, and takes an item find_tier_bonus tiers above an ordinary drop, with the earthborn affix (data/items.json).
_catch_up_note: Catch-up only ever eases a wave, never grows one: a town that pulls ahead keeps its lead. When the round's scheduled wave would be more than catch_up_max_ratio times the town's power level (sim/power.gd, measured as the round starts), raiders are held back until it is not, but the wave keeps at least catch_up_min_share of its scheduled raiders. 0 turns it off.
_camp_note: War camp: raiders catch-up holds back don't vanish. They make one war camp out in the wilds, by a resource node townsfolk gather that sits camp_node_min_distance to camp_node_max_distance from the hearth, camp_offset farther out than the node (never nearer the hearth than camp_min_distance). They roam camp_roam round it day and night, set on anyone who comes close, and townsfolk won't gather any node within camp_hold_radius of it. Later held-back raiders join the same camp, up to camp_max_raiders living; the rest stay away. Battering rams (siege) never camp. When the last camper falls the camp is cleared: the town takes camp_spoils_per_raider shells for every raider that ever joined it, and a hero who struck the last blow also finds an item.
_pact_note: On pact_rounds the relic offer is drawn from relics tagged pact (strong, with a real cost; data/relics.json), topped up from the rest if too few are left; other rounds never offer pacts.
_traditions_note: Founding traditions (data/traditions.json): before round 1 the player picks traditions_to_pick of them. A tradition's buildings come up tradition_card_weight times as often in the building hand, and its leaning's bands form tradition_band_ease townsfolk sooner.
_spoils_note: After each round the relic offer gains one card of spoils (relics tagged spoils, data/relics.json) from the kind of enemy the attack was made of; spoils_kinds names each kind on the card (enemy tag -> what the band of them is called).
_energy_note: Hero energy: drains per second while awake (faster out in the wilds) and per attack, comes back while resting at a lodging (energy_rest x the lodging's rest, x home bonus in a preferred lodging, x rest_rough when sleeping by the hearth). Heroes get up once they reach wake_at. At 0 energy a hero is exhausted and hits for exhausted_attack of normal.
_mood_note: Hero mood, 0-100. Each dawn (and at the end of a round) a hero's mood moves by what happened since the last one: where they slept (sleeping rough by the hearth only counts once the town has a lodging), whether they bought something, prizes earned, comrades lost, hunger and cold. A hero whose mood falls to mood_leave_at or below leaves town with their gear. mood_grumble_at: the story warns you first.
_proud_note: Heroes tagged proud (knights) lose mood_proud_rough_mult times as much for sleeping rough, and gain mood_proud_steel at each dawn while they wear steel.
_family_note: From the age with family_cards_from, one dawn card can be a family: one person of each role in family_roles, arriving together.
_venture_note: Ventures (data/ventures.json): at each dawn, with chance venture_chance, one dawn card is a venture that spends tribespeople for goods, if the town would keep venture_keep_home tribespeople after sending them. Its goods grow by venture_growth_per_round for every round past the first.
_hearty_note: Hearty meals: at each dawn, once everyone has eaten, each hero eats hearty_food more while the store would still hold hearty_reserve_days of the town's daily food; a well-fed hero earns hearty_xp more XP (0.3 = +30%) until the next dawn (sim/people.gd serve_hearty_meals).
